name: images_remove_background
description: Cut-out subject on transparent PNG. A solid-color background is not available over MCP: cut out first, then composite client-side. New AI scene behind the subject: `images_generate` with this image as reference + prompt "replace the background with X" (every client), or `images_replace_background` when it appears in your tools/list.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
